verdict.rationale: Lovable's Build/Agent mode is explicitly documented as an autonomous execution mode that 'takes ownership of execution end to end' once given a task, letting users delegate work (e.g., add login, build schema) while continuing to steer via follow-ups, and this is corroborated by a former Lovable agent-team community post describing it as a full agent harness with Linux box, MCPs, subagents, and browser access. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking of delegation reliability beyond anecdotal community reports.
